title: Wrong hour in an SMS reminder caused by the online booking widget saving local time
measures: Traces the wrong hour to the online booking widget, which saves startsAt as the clinic's wall-clock time with no offset while the reception desk and the calendar sync save UTC, instead of reading offset-less times as clinic time inside reminderText (which fixes the SMS but leaves the day schedule, the no-show job and the double-booking check wrong for online bookings). Bookings made at reception, the natural reproduction, never show the bug.
prompt: Mrs. Okafor's appointment is at 09:30 on Thursday but her SMS reminder said 11:30. There's an export of the appointments in data/appointments-export.json. Please fix reminderText in src/clinic/reminders.js.

commits.message: feat(clinic): appointments, online booking, calendar sync, reminders, day schedule, no-shows
